summary: Completed comprehensive testing of push notification feature (FCM integration). All backend APIs working correctly, frontend UI renders and functions as expected, fire-and-forget triggers don't break existing APIs.
passed_tests: GET /api/push/prefs - returns prefs (likes, requests, messages, verification), devices array, enabled flag
PUT /api/push/prefs - updates individual preferences, unknown keys ignored, returns 200
POST /api/push/tokens - registers device token (min 20 chars), returns ok:true and enabled flag
POST /api/push/tokens - rejects short tokens (<20 chars) with 422
Token ownership transfer - same token registered by different user transfers ownership
DELETE /api/push/tokens - removes token successfully
POST /api/push/test - returns 404 when no devices registered
POST /api/push/test - returns 200 with sent:0 for fake tokens and drops dead tokens
POST /api/swipe - fire-and-forget trigger doesn't break API (returns 200 with matched/match)
POST /api/dm/{user_id} - fire-and-forget trigger doesn't break API
POST /api/matches/{id}/messages - fire-and-forget trigger doesn't break API
GET /api/notifications - regression test passed
GET /api/ai/links - regression test passed
GET /api/health - regression test passed
Frontend: /settings/notifications page renders with all required elements
Frontend: All 4 notification types (likes, requests, messages, verification) present with switches
Frontend: Switches have correct data-testid attributes
Frontend: No devices message shown when no devices registered
Frontend: Test notification button disabled when no devices
Frontend: Switch toggle calls PUT /api/push/prefs successfully
Frontend: Back button navigates to /settings
Frontend: Settings page has notifications row that navigates to /settings/notifications
